description: This file contains date utility functions used across a React-based frontend application for handling dates, especially in the format YYYY-MM-DD. It provides functions for conversion, date arithmetic, range calculations, and grouping by week.

methods.name: toISODateString
methods.description: Converts a Date object to an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) in local time.

methods.name: parseISODateString
methods.description: Parses an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) into a Date object in local time.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds a specified number of days to an ISO date string and returns the new date as an ISO string.

methods.name: diffDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of whole days difference between two ISO date strings.

methods.name: getTodayISO
methods.description: Returns today's date as an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: getLastNDaysRange
methods.description: Returns an array of ISO date strings for the last N days ending at the specified end date (defaults to today).

methods.name: startOfWeekISO
methods.description: Calculates the ISO date string for the start of the week for a given date, with an optional parameter for the starting day of the week.

methods.name: groupISOByWeek
methods.description: Groups an array of ISO date strings into weekly buckets, returning an object with week start dates as keys and counts as values.

methods.name: clampISOToRange
methods.description: Clamps an ISO date string to within a specified start and end ISO date range.
